dialogDescription: Configure an agent profile that can be used to create sessions
roleHint: When role contains "lead", the systemPrompt below auto-fills with the coordinator template (you can still edit it).
systemPromptHint: Template source: docs/lead-prompt-template.md (editing that file changes the pre-filled content for new Lead profiles going forward).
systemPromptPlaceholder: Leave blank = use the agent software's own default behavior
agentSoftwareLabel: Agent software (provider catalog, based on local detection)
sdkTargetHint: Deep integration with Claude Code (requires local login credentials or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
willCreateWith: Will be created with <mono>{{software}}</mono> — command is auto-filled from the detected path:
opencodeHint: Talks to opencode's HTTP + SSE headless server API (not a direct terminal) — supports streaming messages, tool calls, and permission requests.
authModeLoginHint: Uses the local claude login credentials — nothing to fill in here. The model list will only have the fixed aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku/fable), since there's no API key to query the full list in real time.
authModeApiKeyHint: The key entered here is only stored as this profile's env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — it doesn't affect other profiles and isn't written anywhere else (see the existing handling in the environment variables section below).
modelHint: Only lists models enabled in the "Settings" screen (see Settings · Provider management); all disabled is treated as all enabled.
effortHint: xhigh/max are only supported by some newer models; other models have the CLI downgrade them automatically (actual downgrade behavior depends on the CLI version — not assumed here).
argsLabelWithDefaults: args (optional, space-separated, appended after the fixed args)
envLabel: Environment variables (optional, maps to AgentProfile.env — use this to create multiple profiles for the same provider with different credentials, e.g. different ANTHROPIC_API_KEY values)

errors.cliPathNotFound: Could not find the full path for this CLI (path not detected) — switch to "Custom…" to enter it manually
